title: Digital Ethics Case Cards
body_markdown:
# Digital Ethics Case Cards

1. A student submits AI-written work without disclosure.
2. A false story is shared because it is emotionally exciting.
3. A recommendation feed repeatedly rewards outrage.
4. A church leader relies on a chatbot for a crisis response.
5. A family uses AI to simplify a difficult reading passage and checks the result.
6. A user uploads another person's private material to an AI service without permission.

For each case: identify affected people, benefits, risks, evidence classification, one accountable action, and one unanswered question.
